# E0367: a lens computes a value its target rejects for some instance

A computed value has a possible result the target rejects. Here the lens
subtracts one from a non-negative int and writes it where the target requires
a non-negative int: for an input of 0 the result is -1.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int & >=0
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int & >=0
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			n: v0_0.a - 1
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.n
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0367]: n in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is v0_0.a - 1, which may be as low as -1, where the target schema requires >=0
  --> lineage.cue:22:7
   |
22 |             n: v0_0.a - 1
   |                ^^^^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule computed-narrowed)
```
